coverage.inputConstraints:
The first line contains two space-separated integers, n and c (2 ≤ n ≤ 100, 0 ≤ c ≤ 100), — the number of days and the number of kilos of raspberry that the bear should give for borrowing the barrel.

The second line contains n space-separated integers x1, x2, ..., xn (0 ≤ xi ≤ 100), the price of a honey barrel on day i. Unique output; deterministic authored oracle below implements the retained problem description.
